title: Magpie element (magpie.element/1)
description: One thing Magpie keeps meeting (a repo, model, paper, tool or official action) across every edition: what it is, where to find it, what it works with and connects to, and its history. Computed from the published editions and the constraints register; no model writes anything here. Pages exist for elements seen on two or more days, that fed a new possibility, that are official actions, or that an official action rests on, cites, or names the maker of.

slug.description: The file name and the page: /magpie/e/<slug>. A pure function of the key: gh-owner--repo, hf-org--model, hfs-owner--space, arxiv-<id>, policy-fr-<document number>, else a readable stem plus a hash of the key.

key.description: Canonical key: gh:owner/repo, hf:org/model, hfs:owner/space, arxiv:id, url:host/path, policy:...

name.description: What to call it: owner/repo for code and weights, the feed's name for a changelog, else its title.

title.description: The lead source's title at its latest appearance.

lede.description: The editor's latest sentence on what became possible (or, for an action, harder).

summary.description: The source's own words, when the editor never wrote a lede.

first_seen.description: First edition it appeared in since element pages started (elements/index.json `since`).

updated.description: The latest edition that contributed to the page: an appearance or a possibility.

days_seen.description: Editions it appeared in over its whole history: the timeline plus any folded rows.

days_featured.description: Editions in which it was one of Today's five.

find.description: Every address besides the canonical link where it was found, sources first, then discussions, then mentions.

spotted_by.description: Which sources surfaced it, and on how many days.

knock_on.description: Areas the editor said it ripples into, with the effects named.

date.description: The edition that published the possibility.

rank.description: Its place among that day's new possibilities.

key.description: The other element's canonical key; elements/index.json maps it to a page when it has one.

possibilities.description: The newest 60 new possibilities it was an ingredient of, newest first; `possibilities_total` counts all.
New possibilities that combined the two.

together.description: Editions in which one post, video or thread covered both.

via.description: Up to three possibility titles or shared sources.

works_with.description: What it was combined with in new possibilities, then what was covered alongside it.

name.description: Its latest spelling in the sources.

days.description: Appearances in which the editor named it.

how.description: Up to three ways the editor said they connect, newest first.

named_integrations.description: Beside the computed works_with: tools, models or platforms the editor named from the sources' own words in the appearances kept in full, most often named first. Absent when there are none.

match.description: document = the action rests on a document this element links to; reported = this element is one of the action's sources; maker = the action names its maker.

constraints.description: Official actions that name its maker or rest on a document it links to.

constraint.description: For an official action: its current record in constraints.json.

names.description: For an official action: element pages whose maker it names.

date.description: The edition (US Central date) it appeared in. One appearance per edition.

id.description: The event id in that edition: days/<date>.json events[].id.

kind.description: repo, model, space, paper, social, video, newsletter, blog, changelog, community, news or constraint.

title.description: The title the lead source gave it that day.

newly_possible.description: The editor's sentence on what became possible.

newly_constrained.description: For an official action: what it makes harder.

summary.description: The source's own words, when the editor did not write any.

limits.description: What the claim does not prove yet.

signal.description: Computed by code; see the day schema.

impact.description: The editor's rating that day. Absent when the editor did not rate it.

rank.description: Its place in Today's five, when it led the page.

named_integrations.description: The editor's named integrations that day (the brief's works_with), each spelled in that day's own text.

metrics.description: Stars, forks, Hacker News points and Hugging Face counts that day.

doubt.description: The note when X flagged it (a Community Note or credible pushback).

hype.description: The editor judged the evidence mostly launch claims.

read.description: The lead of the read paragraph that cited it that day.

sources.description: Up to eight sources that carried it that day. Older appearances drop their lists.

mentions.description: Up to eight posts that mentioned it in passing.

item.description: That post, video or thread's title.

with.description: Other items the same post, video or thread covered that day (posts covering more than six items are left out).

appearances.description: The newest 60 appearances in full, newest first. Where to find it, who spotted it, knock-on effects and ties come from these; the timeline has every appearance.

timeline.description: Every appearance in the last two years of its history (up to 730 rows) as one short row, newest first. Older rows fold into `older`; counts, peaks and best places cover both.

older.description: What the page no longer holds in full: appearances past the timeline window (counts and extremes), URL matches of appearances past the full window (by action key), and possibilities past the newest 60 (a count).

links.description: Action key to match type, from appearances that left the full window.

possibilities_total.description: New possibilities it fed in all: the newest 60 listed in `possibilities`, plus older ones counted in `older`.
